subject.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads

question: Should this PR land as a proven scoped mitigation while history-prune planning continues to clone full-fidelity messages, or must that remaining worker path also be bounded before merge?
rationale: The patch is correct for summary-oriented operations, but deciding whether the residual history-prune exposure is acceptable requires ownership judgment about compaction completeness and session-state risk.

options.title: Land scoped mitigation
options.body: Merge after rebasing and exact-head validation, while retaining the canonical issue for the remaining history-prune exposure.

options.title: Require complete bounding
options.body: Hold the PR until history-prune planning gains a fidelity-safe bounded representation or a different main-thread/worker result contract.

options.title: Pause the approach
options.body: Close or redesign the branch if maintainers judge the added projection and index protocol too complex for a partial optimization.

recommendation.title: Land scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and exact-head validation, while retaining the canonical issue for the remaining history-prune exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance identifies joshavant as the owner for compaction and Context Engine decisions.
